name: Gifted Education Plan Public Inspection
description: Gifted education plan developed every six years and made available for public inspection and comment at District offices and Township public libraries before Board approval.
deadline: available for at least 28 days prior to Board approval
quote: The District shall develop and implement a gifted education plan every six (6) years, as required by law and regulations. Prior to approval by the Board, the gifted education plan shall be made available for public inspection and comment in the District’s administrative offices and all public libraries in Cheltenham Township for a minimum of twenty-eight (28) days.
